title: Cost Lattice: Charter for adaptive batching, KV-prefetch, and quant profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket is the charter and tracking doc for the Cost Lattice effort: deliver a coordinated set of production-safe optimizations (adaptive batching, KV-prefetch caching, and per-model quantization profiles) that materially reduce per-token inference cost while preserving latency SLOs and output quality. Scope: three parallel workstreams (dynamic batcher + scheduler experiments, KV-prefetch and prefix caching policies, and quant profile validation + canaries). Target customers include hosted API high-throughput customers and Redwood Dedicated pools. Primary success metric is % unit cost reduction on the top 10% of traffic by volume; secondary metrics include P95 latency delta, model quality regressions (automated eval set), and fallback stability metrics. Approach: run k-fold controlled experiments on staging, then gradual canary rollout (1%, 10%, 50%, 100%) with automated rollback gates. We'll maintain a single cost dashboard and an experiment registry to record variant configs and observed deltas. Engineering owners will pair with PM and Design for UX/rollback messaging and error surface handling.
acceptance_criteria: Achieve >=15% reduction in token unit cost on at least two representative workloads without >5% relative increase in P95 latency
No detectable quality regression above the established threshold on automated eval suites for core models (compare baseline against quantized variants)
Canary rollout automation in Console exists: policy to route 1%, 10%, 50% with automatic rollback on defined error or latency gates
Dashboards show cost, latency, and quality signals per-variant and per-route with 24h retention for experiment windows
Runbook updated with rollback steps, customer communication templates, and postmortem checklist
